_comment: Frozen cross-implementation golden vector for the Warren multihop frame (postcard, frame v1). Every language SDK must reproduce these bytes. Any change is a wire break and requires bumping the frame version. Layout: version u8, exit_id [u8;16] raw, epoch varint, seq varint, encapsulated_key [u8;32] raw, aead_tag [u8;16] raw, ciphertext (len varint + bytes).

vectors._comment: version 1, exit_id all 0xa1, epoch 7, seq 42, encap all 0x02, tag all 0x03, ciphertext 0xdeadbeef.
